scope: FMT-09 semantic modes only; scalar composition summary, not a runtime metadata codec or executable domain validator
rules: All semantic inputs and requested outputs must be finite; finite-input overflow fails.
Domain endpoints are exact decimal strings or named parameters; validate parameters under the family contract.
Composition requires matching descriptors, native units/reference, and a stored first-stage result within the second-stage domain.
false bitwise_inverse_cancellation means no general cancellation authorization; true still requires preserving validation, metadata, support and resource behavior.
Raw uses the formula source and NUM outcomes, not these semantic input domains.
